scenes.title: Create an account
scenes.speaker: M’hamed
scenes.screen: Waffles123’s username and masked password; Create account opens setup.
scenes.read: I’m M’hamed. This is DelaStudy, and we’re creating Waffles123’s account.

scenes.title: Personalized onboarding
scenes.speaker: M’hamed
scenes.screen: Onboarding; choices merge into a saved local plan.
scenes.read: We choose our grade and a study goal. Next come our subjects and a course direction. Our school and study preferences shape a saved starting plan on this iPhone.

segments.read: We choose our grade and a study goal.
Next come our subjects and a course direction.
Our school and study preferences shape a saved starting plan on this iPhone.

scenes.title: The student’s desk
scenes.speaker: M’hamed
scenes.screen: Today opens; the diagram’s final node highlights.
scenes.read: Today brings that plan into one place.

scenes.title: Find a course
scenes.speaker: M’hamed
scenes.screen: Browse course levels and search Geometry; three paths converge into search.
scenes.read: The library separates high school, AP preparation, and introductory college paths. Here, we search for Geometry.

scenes.title: A complete course structure
scenes.speaker: M’hamed
scenes.screen: Geometry outline; the diagram shows five units with six activities each.
scenes.read: Each course has five units and at least thirty activities.

scenes.title: Bite-sized lessons
scenes.speaker: Ibby
scenes.screen: Three lesson steps; code 1 saves the position before changing the step.
scenes.read: I’m Ibby. Lessons use three short steps. The code saves our position before advancing, so we can return without losing our place.

scenes.title: Practice, feedback and saving
scenes.speaker: Ibby
scenes.screen: MCQ → blank → matching → save; the diagram follows each question type.
scenes.read: Multiple choice checks our understanding of vertical angles. Next, we fill in one hundred eighty degrees. For matching, we drag the first term, then tap the others into place. Feedback follows our answers. Completion saves the activity and awards its XP once.

scenes.title: Resources, not a wall of text
scenes.speaker: Ibby
scenes.screen: Resources dropdowns; textbooks, full readings and videos form a tree.
scenes.read: Resources separate textbooks, full readings, and videos into expandable categories. Extra material stays outside the lesson.

scenes.title: College preparation
scenes.speaker: Ibby
scenes.screen: College checklist; Explore fields of study is checked.
scenes.read: College planning breaks preparation into steps: explore fields, compare routes, and ask a counselor.

scenes.title: Plan the next session
scenes.speaker: Ibby
scenes.screen: Save Review angle relationships; goal → saved task → Focus session.
scenes.read: We save a specific study task, ready for a Focus session.

scenes.title: Sound with visible playback
scenes.speaker: Sai
scenes.screen: Brown noise plays, pauses and resumes; the diagram contrasts both states.
scenes.read: I’m Sai. Sounds are optional. Playing animates the colored waves; pausing stops them. There’s also a static option for Reduce Motion.

scenes.title: A quieter study view
scenes.speaker: Sai
scenes.screen: Pomodoro countdown; upcoming tasks can be hidden.
scenes.read: Zen puts the timer first. We can hide upcoming tasks when we want fewer distractions.

scenes.title: One useful iOS notification
scenes.speaker: Sai
scenes.screen: Optional alert setting → Home Screen banner → tap; code 2 validates the account and session.
scenes.read: Session-end notifications are optional too. One completion alert appears on the iPhone Home Screen. A tap runs these account and session checks. Only the matching timer opens.

segments.read: One completion alert appears on the iPhone Home Screen.
A tap runs these account and session checks. Only the matching timer opens.

scenes.title: Real progress, one student
scenes.speaker: Sai
scenes.screen: Waffles123’s 20 XP and Stats; saved activities → XP → level progress.
scenes.read: The profile reflects work completed here. That’s DelaStudy: learning, planning, and focused study, connected through saved progress.
